statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial is under reason code CO-197
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, R42
